answer: Shared plot photos let one crew enroll many voters. Each applicant is bound to one numbered farm terrace: they pull a 40 cm soil core, blend it with a measured vial of documented glacier melt, and brush one stroke of the resulting pigment onto a serialized ceramic tile while a sealed camera records the cut. They post H=SHA-256(addr||plot_id||tile_serial||spectrum||mass). Entry costs 0.38 POA, with 11 POA escrowed for eight epochs. Inspectors re-assay the sealed tile against the plot ledger. A reused plot, cloned stroke, or late core burns the escrow and silences both keys for nine epochs.
